meta.notes: whole-country CSV from the Javni geodetski podatki service; rows with ST_STANOVANJA are flats (unit); id EID_NASLOV; house_number HS_STEVILKA plus HS_DODATEK; road ULICA_NAZIV, empty where the address has none (settlement-named addresses), Slovene names not the bilingual _DJ ones; city is the post office name POSTNI_OKOLIS_NAZIV with POSTNI_OKOLIS_SIFRA as postcode; no state; D96/TM EPSG:3794 E,N transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS

operations.EPSG:3794: Inverse of Slovene National Grid + Slovenia 1996 to WGS 84 (1) + axis order change (2D)
